name: How should I prepare before planning a home addition?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare before planning a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planning a home addition begins with identifying your primary goal, establishing a preliminary budget, and checking property boundaries and local zoning setbacks. Consider how the new space connects to existing living areas and whether utility upgrades are required. As an owner-operated general contractor, Abraham Becerra personally meets with homeowners across the Denver area to evaluate structural layouts, measure available space, and outline the scope before framing begins. Having rough dimensions, functional goals, and design inspiration ready beforehand will speed up planning and help determine realistic project milestones.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clarify your functional goals, determine a realistic budget, check property lines, and note utility locations before consulting an on-site general contractor.
